test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: G, H, I, J, K and L are the initials of six girls who were sitting around a circular table discussing the venue of their picnic. They were all facing the table's centre. L was not immediately next to either G or H. I was second to the left of K. There were exactly two girls between J and G. I was to the immediate left of G. K was to the immediate left of H. who was to the immediate right of L?
solution:
According to the given arrangement,

1) I was second to the left of K.

2) I was to the immediate left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8dc0207821d53793c76ffad49540385c76ce356f9822659416bb60542595b10.png] 

3) There were exactly two girls between J and G.

4) K was to the immediate left of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27b8be80c26ef009569ce0379bdbca5bcbb15a3331b398d20a0bd2070205027d.png] 

Here, we can see that 'I' is sitting to the immediate right of L.

Hence, the correct answer is **"I"**.
